name: Augmont Enterprises Limited
summary: Augmont Enterprises Limited operates as an integrated gold and silver platform in India. It engages in procurement and refining, bullion trading, digital gold offerings, jewellery manufacturing, international sales and facilitating gold-backed financial services. The company operates its enterprise sales vertical through its Augmont SPOT' platform, a fully electronic, over-the-counter delivery-based bullion platform that enables such as jewelers, bullion dealers, and manufacturers with valid GST registrations to purchase gold and silver bars online.
